2609.26796.title: Flash-dLLM: IO-Aware KV Caching and Parallel Decoding for Fast, Memory-Efficient Diffusion LLMs
2609.26796.paper_summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs by enabling non-autoregressive text generation. However, their practical deployment remains limited by inefficient inference, largely due to the absence of effective Key-Value (KV) caching and scalable parallel decoding mechanisms. Existing acceleration methods typically study KV caching and parallel decoding in isolation, overlooking the I/O bottlenecks that arise when cache reuse and parallel token verification are jointly applied. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{Flash-dLLM}$, a training-free inference acceleration framework for fast and memory-efficient dLLMs. Flash-dLLM first identifies GPU memory I/O as a dominant bottleneck in KV-cache-enabled dLLM inference and addresses it with an I/O-aware fused KV-cache kernel that reduces redundant memory movement. Building on this optimized cache mechanism, Flash-dLLM further proposes an efficient KV-cache-driven draft-and-verify decoding strategy, where the dLLM itself serves as both drafter and verifier without requiring an auxiliary model. This unified design enables faster decoding while preserving generation quality and improving scalability to longer sequences and larger batch size. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that Flash-dLLM consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art dLLM acceleration methods in both inference speed and memory efficiency. In particular, it achieves $5.1\times$ and $11.0\times$ speedups over prior strongest baseline Elastic-Cache on GSM8K and HumanEval, respectively.
2609.26796.paper_summary_zh: 擴散大型語言模型（dLLMs）最近作為自回歸LLMs的一個有前景的替代方案出現，能夠實現非自回歸文本生成。<lb/>然而，它們的實際部署仍受到低效推理的限制，這在很大程度上是由於缺乏有效的鍵值（KV）緩存和可擴展的並行解碼機制。<lb/>現有的加速方法通常孤立地研究KV緩存和並行解碼，忽視了在聯合應用緩存重用和並行令牌驗證時出現的I/O瓶頸。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們介紹了$\textbf{Flash-dLLM}$，這是一個無需訓練的推理加速框架，用於快速且內存高效的dLLMs。<lb/>Flash-dLLM首先識別GPU內存I/O作為KV緩存啟用的dLLM推理中的主要瓶頸，並通過一個考慮I/O的融合KV緩存內核來解決它，從而減少冗餘的內存移動。<lb/>基於這一優化的緩存機制，Flash-dLLM進一步提出了一種高效的KV緩存驅動的草擬和驗證解碼策略，其中dLLM本身同時擔任草擬者和驗證者，而無需輔助模型。<lb/>這一統一設計實現了更快的解碼，同時保持生成質量並提高對更長序列和更大批量的可擴展性。<lb/>在數學推理和代碼生成基準上的廣泛實驗表明，Flash-dLLM在推理速度和內存效率上始終超越現有的最先進的dLLM加速方法。<lb/>特別是，它在GSM8K和HumanEval上分別實現了對先前最強基線Elastic-Cache的$5.1\times$和$11.0\times$的加速。
